added.summary: A role part on a team (`data-team="a"` or `"b"`: a frame, plate, band, title, row, cell, badge, well, figure, label or heading) wears `--team1` or `--team2` as its ink and rim, so a pack colours every team part by setting the two tokens. The arena kit's team headings now take their team's colour in the default style too.
